abyssal_slime.description: Abyssal slimes surface from the deep abyssal zone only once every couple of decades. Because they are so rarely seen, seamen have often mistaken them for monsters in the past. Many legends of sea monsters were just encounters with the friendly abyssal slime.

ancient_slime.description: Ancient slimes live extremely long lives, spanning centuries upon centuries. They move extremely slowly and often spend months at a time in sleep. However, they are central to the community of slimes and are often friendly with the youth.
ancient_slime.fusionHint: The power of the runes applies to the oldest of things, even animate.

angel_slime.description: Just one touch of the angel slime can heal virtually any injury. The angel slimes have been considered holy and as such many churches have a statue of the angel slime on the rooftop. Many religious followers consider the angel slime to be evidence of God, but scientists are not so sure.
angel_slime.fusionHint: A protector from God, or something else...? Or both?

angler_slime.description: The angler slime lives in the deepest waters known to mankind. Its lure, similar to the bioluminescent slime, is also from bacteria. However, it's unclear how these bacteria got here. It's possible that many thousands of years ago, a bioluminescent slime fused with another deep sea slime to form a primitive angler slime.
angler_slime.fusionHint: A fierce ocean predator that has its own light.

astral_slime.description: The astral slime's body contains pure star matter. These slimes were not fused or born on Earth, but created inside the cores of dying stars. How they got to Earth is still a mystery, but scientists believe astral slimes are critical in furthering the understanding of the universe.

aurora_slime.description: The processes that create the Aurora Borealis phenomena also happen in the internal organs inside the aurora slime. It's unknown why they do this, however scientists suspect that the aurora slime may be using the Earth's magnetic field to feed.

barnacle_slime.description: Barnacle slimes live far longer lives than humans do. The oldest recorded barnacle slime is 350 years old, and continues to live on today. The barnacles on its head grow so large due to the excess of nutrients in the slime.

bat_slime.description: Just like bats, bat slime guano sells for a high price. However, the reason is not a natural resource like nitrogen, but instead that it's used as incense in many rituals around the world.
bat_slime.fusionHint: The night's power doesn't just transform, it blossoms.

battery_slime.description: This manmade slime was created to store electricity efficiently and compactly. A fully charged battery slime (completely green) can power the entire city for an entire day.
battery_slime.fusionHint: The exterior of this slime is built to be hard and strong.

bear_slime.description: The humble bear slime spends much of its day sleeping. The times it's not sleeping, it loves to eat honey. You'll commonly see bear slimes defending bee slimes in exchange for delicious honey.

bee_slime.description: This striped slime communicates with its fellow colony members in a language that sounds like humming a tune. According to linguists, the grammatical structure is similar to Chinese.

berry_slime.description: Berry slimes are only found in a specific season of the year. They secrete a sweet substance that, when paired with peanut butter, makes for a delicious sandwich.

bioluminescent_slime.description: The bioluminescence within this slime is due to small glowing bacteria colonies that are cultivated by a special organ inside the slime. The slime can move these colonies to its tendrils, which it uses to communicate with other lumin slimes.
bioluminescent_slime.fusionHint: Spores of the night may inhabit sea homes, and create something new.

black_hole_slime.description: In 1990, scientists discovered a strange anomaly moving towards the Earth at an extremely fast speed. Upon further inspection, they thought it was a black hole, and panic ensued. However, after further investigation, they discovered the black hole slime. This slime warps spacetime just as a black hole does, but it is just a harmless space-faring slime species.
black_hole_slime.fusionHint: Even the slightest of masses can tip over the limit of gravity, although 'slightest' is relative.

bone_shark_slime.description: This fierce and aggressive slime is the apex slime of the sea. A single bone shark territory can span up to the size of a coastline of an entire continent. These slimes are extremely dangerous and humans should exercise extreme caution upon an encounter.
bone_shark_slime.fusionHint: Scientists were shocked to find more than just the jaw.

butterfly_slime.description: Butterfly slimes come in many different colors and patterns. There are even some butterfly slime species whose patterns, when put together, form a larger image. Also, butterfly slimes love nectar.

candy_slime.description: The candy slime lives a simple but satisfying life. It used to be a regular slime, but it ate so much candy its body changed to look like its food.

cat_slime.description: The cat slime spends its day lazily sleeping. After fishing in the morning it sleeps under the trees in parks around the city.

catfish_slime.description: It's said that much of the world's government is controlled by catfish slimes. The longer the whiskers on a catfish slime, the greater the intelligence they have. At birth they are already twice as smart as the average human.

clay_slime.description: The clay slime can be molded into almost any shape. As a clay slime ages, it develops its ability to morph itself. This allows it to fit into very thin cracks and crevices.

clownfish_slime.description: The clownfish slime's favorite food is cherries. While cherries cannot be found in the slime's natural habitat, they are similar in taste to the 'sea cherry', but in a more elevated manner.
clownfish_slime.fusionHint: The marine jungle-like environment shares a unique relationship to its inhabitants.

coral_slime.description: The coral slime lives in the shallow coral reefs in tropical areas. These slimes are very territorial, and battle with each other using their coral growths for mates and territory.

crystal_slime.description: Crystal slimes are formed under extreme pressure. While it appears that the crystals only grow on top, this is not true. Over time, as the slime moves around, the bottom crystals erode until they fall off completely. The slime may also intentionally break crystals to make movement easier.

drake_slime.description: This horrible beast of a slime has terrorized local villages for centuries. Its vicious appetite for chocolate bars often leaves the surrounding area completely desolated.

dreamer_slime.description: The dreamer slime sleeps so soundly. Of crashing waves and life underwater. Of people and temples from a time long ago. Of a city that looks only forward. Of fields of flowers and nature's wind. The dreamer slime dreams this all. Fast asleep. Dreamers dream of things tomorrow. To dream is to imagine. To create something nobody has seen or understood. The dreamer slime dreams this all.

drone_slime.description: Many city slimes dream of enlisting in the slimilitary and becoming a drone slime. These honorable slimes defend their nation by flying around their enemies while singing the Mission Impossible theme.
drone_slime.fusionHint: Militarized buzzes hum around the city, watching carefully, like insects.

eclipse_slime.description: The eclipse slime changes its color based on the moon phase. However, during solar eclipses it turns completely black with a ring of gold. This mysterious slime is believed by religious followers to be sent from God themself.

finned_slime.description: The fins on the side of their body may look simple at first, but actually are extremely complex appendages that have as much control as human hands do.

fire_slime.description: This slime is always moving around. Its trail is extremely flammable, making it a large concern for preservation organizations around forests. Fire slimes change color depending on how much energy they have, usually following a diurnal cycle: blue in the morning, dark red at night.

firefly_slime.description: When the summer gets too hot, firefly slimes migrate to cooler regions in huge flocks during the night. The horde of firefly slimes is so immense it can be seen from space.
firefly_slime.fusionHint: A beautiful slime that conquers both the night and the sky.

flower_slime.description: A sociable slime that frolics around the grassy meadows. The flowers that grow on their heads come in many forms and form a symbiotic relationship with the slime.

golem_slime.description: The iron rods of this slime help anchor the slime's body together. The stone has fragments of iron within it which lets the slime hold itself together by generating a magnetic field. The inside of the golem slime is liquid magma.
golem_slime.fusionHint: The will to exist can overpower the laws of nature.

grass_slime.description: A carefree slime that spends most of its day sleeping in the sunlight.

guardian_slime.description: The guardian slime once served a great ruler, with the utmost loyalty and chivalry. Now, it looks for a new leader to defend.
guardian_slime.fusionHint: Devotion often binds people and slimes together, forming a new kind of being altogether.

his_purness_slime.description: Hey! Who let an orange cat slime become king?

hologram_slime.description: The hologram slime is made completely out of light. Because of this unique ability, it can also teleport using the quantum properties of light.
hologram_slime.fusionHint: Modern technology often behaves in strange ways, making fictional characters seemingly come to life.

honey_slime.description: The honey dipper inside the honey slime is critical to its shape, functioning similar to a skeleton. The honey slime's honey is considered one of the most delicious honeys in the world.
honey_slime.fusionHint: As sweet as a treat and as snug as a bug. Nature's treat, so to speak.

hunter_slime.description: The hunter slime's mask is handpainted and hand carved. It vaguely resembles a slime-eater which wards off other slimes. The hunter slime lives its life in solitude, but is friendly and even cooperative with humans.

jetpack_slime.description: A passionate slime who decided to conquer the skies.
jetpack_slime.fusionHint: The possibility of creating anything inspires many slimes. The sky's the limit.

kelp_slime.description: The kelp slime has massive social anxiety and spends most of its time hiding in the kelp forest. Sometimes, kelp slimes even move their kelp growths in front of their eyes to disappear from a conversation.

matrix_slime.description: A self aware computer virus that calls itself Matrix Slime. Nobody is sure exactly how it appeared, but since it didn't appear to be harmful, the government didn't try to destroy it.

mayor_slime.description: A slime who cares for its people and represents the slime party. The slime party has won the mayoral election for New Slime City for 10 cycles in a row.

metal_slime.description: The unique filtering properties of the metal slime's body make it interesting for refining technologies.

moon_slime.description: The moon slime is rarely seen, and only appears on nights with full moons. When the sun comes up, they vanish. The crater-shaped indent on its head is different for each moon slime.

neon_slime.description: This slime's colorful neon body is what inspired the city aesthetic for New Slime City.

nimbus_slime.description: An amicable slime that spends its time floating in the sky. Because its body is so light, it rarely ever comes to the surface.

nyan_slime.description: This colorful slime became a huge meme in New Slime City. Soon, people were dressing up as the nyan slime for Halloween and naming their own cats Nyan. This slime has a pixelated appearance, which is due to its unique square-shaped DNA.

opal_slime.description: The slime's body is considered one of the most beautiful things to ever exist. It has appeared across centuries of art and study.
opal_slime.fusionHint: Shiny as a gem and as bright as the night.

pearlescent_slime.description: The pearl slime is considered by many to be the perfect slime. For good reason, its skin is a thin film, like a bubble or pearl which creates wondrous and colorful patterns. The main character of the kids show 'Slimez Rule' is a pearl slime named Whitney.
pearlescent_slime.fusionHint: The spines guard a valuable secret.

phosphor_slime.description: On some nights in June, phosphor slimes come to the surface from their cave hideaways to socialize and mate. For towns nearby fields where this occurs, it's common for couples to watch this spectacle together. Depending on the region, phosphor slimes may also be orange.
phosphor_slime.fusionHint: The power of the moon can transform nature in mysterious ways.

pirate_slime.description: While the pirate slime's costume display may fool your average joe, scientists know that the slime is sweet as pie. The slime actually has two eyes, so the eyepatch is purely decorative. Slimes can regenerate any body part.

planet_slime.description: Planet slimes generate their own gravitational field, although it's unknown how they do this. This has been observed by scientists as planet slimes pull fruits off trees using localized gravitational fields.
planet_slime.fusionHint: Cosmic dust arranged just right can create beautiful bodies of enormous proportion.

plush_slime.description: The plush slime is extremely gentle and friendly, making it a great companion for young children and elderly folk.

pollen_slime.description: During the spring season, the natural charge built up on these slimes attracts pollen to their bodies, which builds up like a layer of fur. Depending on the nearby plant species, the color of these slimes vary. Rarely, you may see a pollen slime with no pollen, which is actually purple.
pollen_slime.fusionHint: Pollinating slimes often hang around flowers.

pot_slime.description: The pot slime has openings where its eyes and mouth should be, carved long ago. It's said that the pot slime manifested existence from an actual slime statue. The slime's body is full of water, from which plants can grow.
pot_slime.fusionHint: Hot temperatures can cause permanent change.

power_slime.description: This slime is constantly on the move. Its body is made of pure energy, which can disrupt power. This power makes this slime a particular nuisance.

prism_slime.description: These bombastic slimes love to play tricks on other slimes and cause trouble. However, because their shape is more geometric, they have difficulty traversing the terrain at times.
prism_slime.fusionHint: Sometimes feeling small only requires a spark to be changed forever.

rainbow_slime.description: Stories from those that have seen the rainbow slime said great fortune has always come to them after their encounter. As time has passed, the rainbow slime has become a symbol of fortune and luck and is often paraded as a balloon during New Year's.

reef_slime.description: The coral skeleton horns on the reef slime are there simply because the coral decided to move to the skin of the reef slime. Over time, the reef slime will be completely covered and when it dies, it will join the existing reef.
reef_slime.fusionHint: The reef is nothing without its colorful homes.

robo_slime.description: The robo slime was created as a personal slime assistant for families. The first version Ro-bo Slime MK1 was recalled due to a bug in the code that led to the ro-bo slime being obsessed with chocolate.
robo_slime.fusionHint: New technologies have a way of building upon the powers of the past and ancient.

royal_slime.description: The royal slime has a very stubborn and unpleasant attitude. The crown on its head once belonged to a great ruler.

runic_slime.description: The glowing runes on the surface of the runic slime grant power. Humans used these runic slimes to assist them in their everyday tasks. Thus, each runic slime's runes were hand-carved for a specific purpose.

samara_slime.description: While real samara seeds use their wing-shaped geometry as a seed dispersion technique, the samara slime uses it to get to fruit hanging from tall trees.
samara_slime.fusionHint: The wind carries seeds to places they could never go alone.

sand_slime.description: The sand slime's body is almost completely made out of sand and water. Because of the natural result of sand's filtering properties, the core of the slime is a small water reservoir. As a result, many small animals such as crabs or starfish can live inside a sand slime.

sandcastle_slime.description: Sandcastle slimes are descended from fortress slimes, which were alive during the medieval era. These slimes, while a sliver of the might of a fortress slime — which was believed to be as tall as a human — still carry the same resilient and loyal personality.
sandcastle_slime.fusionHint: Without a flag to defend, a tower of sand is just a block.

shark_slime.description: Shark slimes can swim at astounding speeds, even faster than actual sharks. The gills on the side of their body are purely decorative; slimes do not require lungs or gills to respirate, as they absorb oxygen through their skin.

skeleton_slime.description: Don't be distracted by the slime's cute appearance. One touch of its toxic gelatinous body is enough poison to kill a horse. If you encounter this slime, it's best not to stay for long.

sleepy_slime.description:
The sleepy slime isleigrselr zuoigioenf 


 (The author must have fallen asleep while writing.)

slime_slime.description: The slime slime's slime causes slime to ooze from other slime slimes' slime pores causing a chain reaction of slime slime slime.
slime_slime.fusionHint: Drainage pipes often lead to the ocean, creating a poisonous swamp.

spirit_slime.description: This slime has been said to have emerged from the essence of will manifesting itself. The spirit slime is very prevalent in cultures around the world, as a symbol for life. It is believed to have been the precursor to all known slimes, which, if true, would make it the oldest known slime species.

sun_slime.description: This slime radiates warm sunlight in a similar fashion to the sun, making it very interesting to scientists as a possible source of energy.

sunflower_slime.description: The flower on its head can actually tilt a couple degrees so that it faces towards the sun.
sunflower_slime.fusionHint: The flower on its head closely resembles the sun.

teddy_slime.description: This furry slime is super soft and loves strawberries.
teddy_slime.fusionHint: A stuffed animal comes to life in the mind of a child.

tempest_slime.description: The tempest slime can control both weather and sea currents. It uses these to travel quickly across continents every day in search for food.

tv_slime.description: The TV slime's program changes depending on its mood. Political debates seem to be its angry program.
tv_slime.fusionHint: Harnessed light can show things never seen before, live!

urchin_slime.description: It's better not to get on the bad side of an urchin slime. These spiny slimes have a short temper, and they'll never forget a grudge. Keeping these slimes as pets is risky but rewarding, as they also have fierce loyalty.

wind_slime.description: Wind slimes are very serious slimes. They expect perfection out of other slimes, and so get disappointed easily. These slimes have developed wing-like appendages that allow them to travel at speeds upwards of 300 mph.
wind_slime.fusionHint: The grass and the weather are always in close contact.
